Route 66 barbershop builds community through license plate stories
summary: A Route 66 barber has turned his shop into a community gathering place with a collection of about 400 license plates donated by customers and travelers from around the world.

title: Person dies in crash on US 6 near Soldier Summit
summary: A person died in a crash on U.S. Highway 6 near Soldier Summit on Friday night, according to the Utah Department of Public Safety. The crash shut down traffic for several hours, according to the Utah Highway Patrol.

title: Winter weather creates challenges for Utah drivers
summary: Crashes and road closures are adding to travel concerns as winter weather settles into the state. On US-40, a crash involving an 18-wheeler forced the highway to close for a time on Friday.
